identity.name: Linux Endpoint: Adding Execution Privileges via chmod +x
identity.summary: An attacker downloads a binary to /tmp, sets execution permissions using chmod +x, and then executes it. Cortex should detect the chmod +x operation as a deviation from normal behavior.

biocs.name: Adding execution privileges
biocs.description: Detection of chmod +x being executed on a file in /tmp
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = '/bin/chmod' and action_file_path like '/tmp/%'
| filter action_process_command_line like '%+x%'
